name: Bloom
description: "After every winter comes a spring. Though life may wane, it will return."

abilities.name: Lifebloom
abilities.description: +0.5 Cute. Small plants sprout where they tread. Camp action: grow two servings of raw plant.

abilities.name: Soul Regrowth
abilities.description: When Focusing Soul to heal, may choose living bug within 3 squares to receive healing.

abilities.name: Ally of the Wilds
abilities.description: Can speak to plants and feral creatures (may be cryptic/crude).

abilities.name: Resonant Soul
abilities.description: When Focusing Soul to Heal, +1 die per friendly living thing within 4 squares (max Bloom Rank). Opposed Insight check can treat enemy as friendly for one turn.

abilities.name: Heart of Magic
abilities.description: When Spell Focusing, may reduce cost of next Soul Focus instead of next Spell.

abilities.name: Full Bloom
abilities.description: When Focusing Soul to heal others, all dice are successes.

abilities.name: Force of Nature
abilities.description: Regain Stamina normally when on Death's Door. Survive lethal effect with 1 Heart once per round (if not on Death's Door).
